recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. If the work group still wants Address or HumanName comment examples or separate non-ContactPoint comment extensions, handle that as a new Extension Pack issue rather than changing core in this run.
issue_request: FHIR-21000 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested a way to attach a free-text comment to a patient's phone number or other ContactPoint such as email; the recorded resolution said to define a standard extension for comments on phone numbers, addresses, and names, with examples such as pronunciation or usage notes.
initial_application: Core commit 732b40c16876bd7f23e75b50253824d920485f4e explicitly listed FHIR-21000 and added a 0..1 string ContactPoint comment extension row to source/datatypes/contactpoint-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. Later commit dd468d4f17 removed R5 extension definitions from core as part of the move to the Extension Pack.
additional_context: Core source/history.html states that extensions moved to hl7.fhir.uv.extensions while source/oids.ini preserves the contactpoint-comment OID. The Extension Pack currently defines an active ContactPointComment extension with ContactPoint and ExtendedContactDetail contexts and a string value. Later FHIR-41563, supported by FHIR-41560 and approved in FHIR-I minutes, clarified how contactpoint-comment differs from ContactPoint-purpose, and that clarification is present in the current Extension Pack source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current core checkout is correct to omit the extension definition because extension definitions now belong to the Extension Pack, and the authoritative Extension Pack source satisfies the ContactPoint support requested by FHIR-21000 after later clarification.
